name: Jägerhof
beschreibung: The Jägerhof is picturesquely situated in a quiet panoramic location in Jerzens in the Pitztal Valley. This traditional alpine inn exudes authentic charm, showcased by its wood-paneled stone-pine parlors, a classic tiled stove, and heartfelt family hospitality. Cozy guest rooms furnished in rustic Tyrolean country style offer spectacular views of the surrounding Pitztal peaks. The kitchen delights guests with hearty regional classics including Tiroler Gröstl, Käsespätzle, and homemade pastries prepared with local produce. In summer, the inn serves as a gateway to the Hochzeiger hiking trails, while winter guests enjoy quick access to the snow-sure Hochzeiger ski slopes.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional alpine inn in Jerzens in the Pitztal Valley featuring wood-paneled parlors and mountain panoramas.
